Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) support for Citus 10.1 is generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) support for Citus 10.1

Now supported in general availability on Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus), the latest Citus 10.1 version includes columnar storage for Postgres, joins and foreign keys between local Postgres and Citus tables, improved SQL and Data Definition Language support, simplified operations, and more. You can start using Citus 10.1 by creating an Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Hyperscale (Citus) server group with PostgreSQL 12 or 13.

Learn more.
